== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1638. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-992|William Glasgow]] and [[Howie-1119|Bessie Howie]]. She passed away about 1642, as previously estimated; no burial record has yet been identified for that estimate.

The same parents had another Margaret recorded on 16 November 1643, represented by [[Glasgow-1524]]. The entries have different dates, so their identity needs to be checked against the original register before considering a merge.
